title: Headroom - Compress 60-95 Percent of AI Agent Tokens Without Losing Quality
summary:
The Token Problem

Every AI agent has a hidden tax. Tool outputs logs RAG chunks files conversation history all consume tokens. Headroom a new open-source project currently #1 on GitHub Trending with 3500 stars today solves this.

How It Works

Headroom compresses everything your AI agent reads before it reaches the LLM. Tool outputs logs RAG chunks files conversation history. Same answers fraction of the tokens.

Live example from their README. 10144 tokens compressed to 1260 tokens and the same answer was found.

Four Ways to Use It

  1. Library - compress in Python or TypeScript inline in any app
  2. Proxy - headroom proxy port 8787 zero code changes
  3. Agent Wrap - headroom wrap claude codex cursor aider copilot
  4. MCP Server - for any MCP client

What Makes It Special

Reversible Compression CCR. Originals never deleted LLM retrieves on demand. Cross-Agent Memory shared store across Claude Codex Gemini with auto-dedup. Self-Learning headroom learn mines failed sessions writes corrections to CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md.

Why This Matters

AI agents need context. Context costs tokens. Headroom lets agents keep more context for less cost. Essential for workflows with long tool execution chains.

pip install headroom
headroom wrap claude

Or point your app to headroom proxy port 8787.

title: Ethical Hacking: Building the Next Generation of Cyber Security Professionals
summary:
Ethical hacking is the authorized process of identifying vulnerabilities in computer systems and networks to strengthen security defenses. Unlike malicious hackers, ethical hackers work within legal boundaries to prevent cyber attacks and protect digital assets. With the rapid expansion of online services, ethical hacking has become a critical component of cyber security.

Organizations across sectors rely on ethical hackers to test their systems, identify weaknesses, and recommend solutions. Ethical hacking involves techniques such as penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and security auditing. These practices help prevent data breaches, financial losses, and reputational damage.

At Poddar International College, ethical hacking concepts are introduced as part of the cyber security curriculum in bca course in jaipur and mca course in jaipur programs. Students learn how cyber attacks occur and how they can be prevented using secure coding practices and system monitoring tools. The academic approach combines classroom learning with practical exercises, helping students gain hands-on experience.

The college encourages project-based learning where students simulate real-life cyber scenarios. Through laboratory sessions and case studies, learners analyze security incidents and develop preventive strategies. This practical exposure enhances analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, preparing students for professional roles in cyber security.

As a leading IT college in jaipur, the institution emphasizes experiential learning and industry-relevant training to ensure students understand the practical aspects of cyber security and digital risk management. Modern infrastructure and technology-enabled learning environments support students in developing the technical competencies required by the industry.

Students also benefit from advanced computing facilities such as the Apple Lab in jaipur, which provides access to contemporary technology platforms and enhances their exposure to diverse computing environments. Such resources help learners strengthen their technical skills and adapt to evolving industry demands.

Ethical hacking also promotes responsible use of technology. Students are taught the importance of legal compliance and professional ethics. As cyber threats continue to rise, the need for trained ethical hackers is increasing globally. By fostering technical competence and ethical awareness, Poddar International College empowers students to become trusted cyber security professionals in the digital age.

title: How I built a fast YouTube Sponsorship Calculator in Vanilla JS
summary:
As developers running tech newsletters, blogs, or YouTube channels, getting your first sponsor is exciting—until you realize you have no idea how much to charge. I was tired of guessing my rates, so I built a clean, client-side Sponsorship Calculator.

The Approach

I built this using 100% Vanilla JS. Since audience metrics and revenue goals are private business data, I made sure there are zero server calls. Everything runs locally in your browser.

Here is a quick look at the core logic handling the CPM (Cost Per Mille) and premium placement calculations:

function calculateSponsorshipRate(averageViews, cpmRate) {
    // CPM represents the cost per 1,000 views or subscribers
    const baseRate = (averageViews / 1000) * cpmRate;

    // Add a standard 25% markup for premium/top-of-page placements
    const premiumRate = baseRate * 1.25;

    return {
        standardPrice: Math.round(baseRate),
        premiumPrice: Math.round(premiumRate)
    };
}

Try it out

You can use the live tool for free here: Youtube Sponsorship Calculator

Let me know what you think or if you'd add any other metric variables in the comments!

title: MemPalace 52K Stars - AI Memory System That Never Forgets You
summary:
Ever Felt Like AI Has Amnesia

You talk to an AI for an hour telling it your name preferences project context and 10 minutes later it remembers nothing. This is not because AI is dumb. It lacks long-term memory.

MemPalace an open-source project with 52,000 GitHub stars solves exactly this problem. It won the LongMemEval benchmark and is the hottest AI memory solution right now.

How It Works

MemPalace uses a 4-level memory structure. Palace Wing Room Drawer. Think of it like a well-organized filing cabinet where each drawer holds specific information retrieved precisely when needed.

The Key Innovation Store Original Text Not Summaries

Most memory systems compress and summarize conversations before storing them. Summarization loses information. MemPalace stores the original text and uses structural hierarchy for retrieval. This is a fundamentally better approach.

Performance

In LongMemEval benchmark testing MemPalace achieves 96.6% Top-5 retrieval accuracy ranking first. And everything runs locally with zero API costs.

Practical Uses

  • AI Writing - remembers your style preferences
  • Coding Assistant - remembers project structure and habits
  • Learning Companion - remembers what you already learned
  • Personal Assistant - remembers schedule preferences important dates

Installation 

pip install mempalace

One line. It integrates with Claude Code and other AI tools via MCP protocol. Pure Python works on Windows Linux Mac.

The Debate

52K stars in 50 days is impressive but the AI memory space is crowded with many solutions claiming to be the best. What sets MemPalace apart is the store-original-not-summary approach which is technically sounder than compression-based alternatives.

If you have deep conversations with AI this is worth trying.

title: Free Claude Code - 29K Stars Zero API Costs Full Claude Workflow
summary:
Claude Code is Great But the API Bill Hurts

Claude Code is arguably the best AI coding assistant right now. But at $0.80/M input tokens and $4/M output tokens a heavy user can easily burn hundreds of dollars a month.

A new open-source project with 29,000 GitHub stars called free-claude-code solves this in a clever way. It inserts a local proxy between Claude Code and the API redirecting Anthropic requests to free or low-cost providers without changing Claude Code workflow.

How It Works

The architecture is dead simple. free-claude-code starts a local FastAPI server on port 8082. All API requests from Claude Code pass through this proxy first. The proxy forwards requests to one of 17 third-party providers. Claude Code workflow streaming tool calls and chain-of-thought stays intact.

Supported Providers

The proxy supports 17 providers including Kimi DeepSeek NVIDIA NIM Google Gemini Groq and even local models via Ollama. Each provider can be configured to handle different model tiers independently.

Key Advantages

Zero API Fees - Route all requests to free providers. Full Workflow Preservation - Streaming output tool calls and chain-of-thought all work. Request Optimization - Local probe requests answered directly saving quota and time. One-Click Switching - Change providers through Admin UI without restart.

Try It Yourself 

git clone https://github.com/yournextstore/free-claude-code
cd free-claude-code
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py

Then configure Claude Code to use localhost:8082 as its API endpoint. 29,000 stars tell a clear story - developers want Claude Code workflow not Claude Code bill.

title: How to Style a Disco Cowboy Hat: The Ultimate Fashion Guide for Bold Western Looks
summary:
How to Style a Disco Cowboy Hat and Turn Every Outfit Into a Statement
There is something undeniably electric about a disco cowboy hat. It takes the rugged soul of western fashion and wraps it in shimmer, sequins, and pure showstopping confidence. Whether you are heading to a music festival, a themed birthday bash, or just want to inject some serious personality into your wardrobe, knowing how to style a disco cowboy hat properly makes all the difference. This guide walks you through everything from outfit pairings to accessory choices, so you can wear this iconic piece with intention and flair, not just as an afterthought. Get ready to ride into every room like you own the dance floor.

Understanding the DNA of Disco Cowboy Hats and Western Fashion
Before you can style something well, you need to understand what it is. Disco cowboy hats sit at the intersection of two distinct cultural movements: the gritty, grounded world of western hats and the flamboyant, mirror-ball energy of 1970s disco fashion. The result is a hybrid accessory that refuses to be subtle.
Traditional western hats were designed for function. Wide brims blocked the sun, the structured crown protected the head, and the overall silhouette communicated a certain stoic authority. Disco fashion, on the other hand, was all about excess, reflection, and celebration. When the two collide, you get a hat that carries the familiar cowboy silhouette but is covered in metallic fabric, holographic sequins, glitter finishes, or rhinestone trim.
Understanding this dual identity helps you make smarter styling decisions. You are not just wearing a novelty hat. You are making a cultural reference. That means you can lean into either side of its heritage depending on the occasion. Pair it with classic denim and boots for a western-leaning look, or go full retro glam with flared pants and a bodysuit for pure disco energy. The hat holds both worlds together.

How to Style a Disco Cowboy Hat for Different Occasions
The real power of disco cowboy hats lies in their versatility, if you know how to deploy them correctly. Here is how to work this accessory across several different settings.
Music Festivals
Festival style is probably the most natural home for this hat. The combination of open skies, loud music, and a crowd that rewards creative dressing makes it the perfect environment. Pair a silver or gold sequined cowboy hat with high-waisted denim shorts, a cropped fringe top, and chunky platform boots. Add a few cowboy accessories like a beaded belt or a turquoise cuff bracelet to reinforce the western thread without losing the party energy. Keep your makeup bold, think glossy lips or graphic liner, because the hat is already doing the heavy lifting up top.
Theme Parties and Costume Events
For a disco-themed party, this hat is practically a costume on its own. Build a full look around it with a metallic wrap dress or wide-leg sequin trousers, a simple bodysuit, and strappy heeled sandals. The hat signals the theme immediately, which means your outfit underneath can stay relatively simple. You do not need to over-costume when your headwear is this loud.
Casual Daywear
Yes, you can wear a disco cowboy hat on a regular day. The key is contrast. Let the hat be the single statement piece and keep everything else understated. A white linen shirt, straight-leg jeans, and clean white sneakers create the perfect low-key canvas. The hat pops against the simplicity of the rest of the outfit, and you come across as intentionally stylish rather than costumed.
Bachelorette Parties and Girls' Nights
This is one context where a matching set of festival hats genuinely elevates the group aesthetic. Coordinating party accessories across a group creates visual cohesion and turns your crew into a roaming spectacle in the best possible way.

Practical Tips for Wearing and Caring for Your Hat
Styling is only half the equation. Knowing how to wear and maintain your disco cowboy hat keeps it looking great across many occasions.
Getting the Fit Right
A cowboy hat that sits too high on the head looks unstable and loses its authority. It should rest just above your ears with the brim parallel to the ground. If your hat feels loose, a foam hat sizing strip inside the crown solves the problem quickly and cleanly. A proper fit also means the hat stays put when you are dancing, which matters more than people think.
Working With Your Hair
Your hairstyle affects how the hat reads. Long loose waves or a low side braid sit beautifully under a cowboy brim and add a romantic western texture. A sleek high ponytail pulled through the back creates a sporty, modern contrast with the glam of the sequins. For shorter hair, let the hat do its thing. You do not need volume underneath to make it work.
Cleaning Sequined and Metallic Finishes
Sequin and metallic fabric hats require gentle handling. Spot-clean with a slightly damp cloth rather than soaking the material. Avoid heat sources, as many metallic fabrics warp or lose their finish when exposed to high temperatures. Store the hat in a cool, dry place with a bag or box that protects the brim shape. A misshapen brim is very difficult to reverse at home.
Matching Metals
If your hat is gold, your accessories should lean gold. Silver hat with silver jewelry. Mixing metals can work in everyday fashion, but against a sequined hat, it creates visual noise rather than intentional contrast. Keep your metals consistent and the whole look reads as considered.

*
Why Disco Cowboy Hats Are Trending Right Now
The current popularity of disco cowboy hats is not random. It reflects several converging trends in fashion, music, and cultural mood.
Country music has had a significant pop crossover moment in recent years. Artists from outside the genre have incorporated western imagery into their visuals and performances, introducing cowboy silhouettes to audiences who had never previously engaged with that aesthetic. At the same time, the Y2K and retro revival trend brought holographic fabrics, sequins, and maximalist accessories back into mainstream fashion conversation. Disco cowboy hats arrived at the exact point where those two trends overlapped.
Festival culture has also played a major role. Coachella, Stagecoach, and similar large-scale events function as annual showcases for statement accessories. A hat that is visually distinctive and photographs beautifully is practically designed for that environment. Social media amplification did the rest.
Beyond trends, there is a psychological element. People are reaching for joy-forward fashion. Pieces that are unapologetically fun and visually celebratory align with a broader cultural desire to dress with intention rather than blend in. Disco cowboy hats carry that energy naturally.
If you are looking for a quality selection of styles in sequined, metallic, holographic, and rhinestone finishes, discocowboyhatshops.com is one of the best places to explore the full range of what this category has to offer. The variety available makes it easy to find a hat that suits your specific look rather than settling for a generic one-size-fits-all option.

Conclusion: Own the Hat, Own the Room
A disco cowboy hat is not a shy accessory, and it does not reward timid styling. The more intentional your outfit choices, the more powerful this hat becomes as a centerpiece. Start with fit, build your look around the hat rather than adding it as an afterthought, and do not be afraid to commit fully to whatever direction you choose, whether that is western-grounded or full-on disco glam.
The beauty of this accessory is that it already contains multitudes. It carries a century of cowboy iconography and five decades of disco culture in a single brim. All you have to do is wear it with confidence.
Now it is your turn. What is your go-to outfit for wearing a disco cowboy hat? Are you more of a festival maximalist or a casual daywear minimalist? Drop your answer in the comments because there is no wrong way to answer that question.

Now it is your turn. What is your go-to outfit for wearing a disco cowboy hat? Are you more of a festival maximalist or a casual daywear minimalist? Drop your answer in the comments because there is no wrong way to answer that question.

title: Trust Needs Evidence: Why Digital Verification Is Entering a New Era
summary:
The digital economy runs on trust.

Every online transaction, employee onboarding process, educational certification, healthcare record exchange, and government service depends on the assumption that the information being shared is authentic. Yet in an environment where data can be copied, manipulated, or stolen, trust can no longer rely solely on declarations or centralized databases.

Organizations are discovering a new reality: trust must be supported by verifiable evidence.

This shift is fueling the adoption of digital identity systems, verifiable credentials, blockchain-powered verification, and automated compliance technologies that make trust measurable rather than assumed.

The Trust Problem Behind Digital Transformation

Businesses have spent years investing in digital transformation initiatives. Processes that once required face-to-face interactions now happen entirely online.

While this has improved efficiency, it has also introduced new challenges:

  • Identity fraud is increasing.
  • Verification processes remain fragmented.
  • Compliance requirements continue to grow.
  • Organizations struggle to validate information across multiple systems.

Traditional verification methods often involve manual reviews, document uploads, and repeated checks. These approaches slow operations, increase costs, and create opportunities for error.

As digital ecosystems expand, organizations need verification mechanisms that are faster, more reliable, and easier to trust.

Why Verification Is Becoming More Important Than Identity

For years, organizations focused on collecting identity information.

Today, the focus is shifting toward verifying that information.

Knowing who someone claims to be is no longer enough. Organizations need confidence that credentials, certifications, licenses, and records are genuine and current.

This evolution is driving demand for:

  • Digital identity verification
  • Identity proofing software
  • Digital identity management solutions
  • Credential verification systems
  • Digital trust services

The goal is simple: establish trust without creating friction.

Enter Verifiable Credentials

Verifiable Credentials represent a major advancement in how digital trust is established.

Unlike traditional documents, verifiable credentials are cryptographically secured and designed to be independently verified. They can represent educational achievements, professional certifications, employee qualifications, government-issued identities, and many other forms of trusted information.

Instead of repeatedly submitting documents for review, individuals can present verified digital credentials that can be authenticated instantly.

This creates benefits for everyone involved:

For Individuals

  • Greater control over personal information
  • Faster verification processes
  • Improved privacy
  • Reduced administrative burden

For Organizations

  • Lower verification costs
  • Increased operational efficiency
  • Stronger fraud prevention
  • Better compliance outcomes

Trust becomes portable, reusable, and scalable.

Blockchain's Role in the Verification Revolution

The growing adoption of blockchain technology is accelerating this transformation.

Blockchain provides a secure and immutable framework for recording credential issuance and verification events. Once information is recorded, it becomes extremely difficult to alter without detection.

This capability makes blockchain particularly valuable for digital trust applications.

Organizations are increasingly exploring blockchain identity solutions to support:

  • Credential issuance
  • Identity verification
  • Compliance reporting
  • Supply chain validation
  • Workforce credential management

By creating transparent and tamper-resistant verification environments, blockchain helps organizations move from trust-by-assumption to trust-by-evidence.

Compliance Is Becoming Continuous

Compliance has traditionally been reactive.

Organizations collect documentation, prepare audits, and respond to regulatory requirements when necessary.

However, modern regulatory environments demand greater visibility and accountability.

This is where compliance automation software is changing the game.

By integrating credential verification directly into operational workflows, organizations can continuously validate qualifications, certifications, and compliance requirements in real time.

Benefits include:

  • Automated audit readiness
  • Reduced compliance costs
  • Improved reporting accuracy
  • Faster onboarding processes
  • Stronger governance practices

Verification becomes an ongoing process rather than a periodic event.

The Rise of Decentralized Identity

Another important development is decentralized identity.

Traditional identity systems depend heavily on centralized databases that create security risks and privacy concerns.

Decentralized identity models allow individuals to maintain ownership and control over their credentials while selectively sharing verified information when needed.

This approach reduces unnecessary data exposure and enables more secure interactions across organizations.

As digital ecosystems become increasingly interconnected, decentralized identity is expected to play a central role in the future of digital trust.

Building a Verification-First Future

The next generation of digital infrastructure will not be defined solely by connectivity or automation.

It will be defined by trust.

Organizations, governments, educational institutions, and enterprises are recognizing that verification must become a foundational capability rather than an afterthought.

Digital credentials, blockchain verification, identity proofing technologies, and compliance automation solutions are creating a world where trust can be established instantly and confidently.

In this new era, evidence matters more than claims.

And the organizations that embrace verification-first strategies today will be the ones best prepared for tomorrow's digital economy.

Final Thoughts

Trust has always been essential to business and society. What is changing is how trust is established.

Instead of relying on paper records, manual reviews, or centralized authorities alone, organizations are adopting technologies that enable trust to be verified at the speed of digital interaction.

The future belongs to systems that can prove authenticity, validate credentials, and establish confidence through evidence.

Because in a connected world, trust is no longer something we assume it's something we verify.

Connect with EveryCRED to discover how verifiable credentials and digital identity technologies can help your organization build secure, scalable, and trusted digital ecosystems.

title: Why Hardcoded Recipes Beat AI: Building a Filipino Meal Cost Engine with Real Market Data
summary:
Every Filipino household has heard this question at least ten thousand times:

"Ma, ano ulam?" (Mom, what's for dinner?)

It's so universal it's practically a national catchphrase. And now that I'm the one who cooks and shops at the wet market (palengke), I hear it in my own head — every single day.

The problem isn't cooking. It's deciding what to cook when ingredient prices change daily and you're trying to stretch a budget.

So I built a web app to answer the question with math instead of guesswork.

Live: ma-anoulam.vercel.app
GitHub: chanrylejay/ano-ulam

The Problem

Here in the Philippines, the Department of Agriculture publishes a daily price bulletin called Bantay Presyo — it tracks commodity prices (vegetables, meat, fish, rice, cooking oil) across Metro Manila markets and supermarkets. It's publicly available as a PDF on their website.

The data exists. But nobody is using it to help regular people decide what to cook.

I wanted to build something that:

  • Pulls real market prices every day automatically
  • Figures out which meals are cheapest to cook right now
  • Shows per-ingredient cost breakdowns so you know exactly what you're spending
  • Runs by itself with no manual work

V1: The AI Approach (And Why It Failed)

My first instinct was to let AI handle everything. I sent the price data to DeepSeek and asked it to generate Filipino recipe suggestions with cost estimates.

The results were... not great.

Accuracy: 6-7 out of 10.

Here's what went wrong:

  • Wrong ingredients: It would suggest "Sinigang na Baboy" but include ingredients that don't belong in sinigang
  • English names: It used "eggplant" instead of "talong," "string beans" instead of "sitaw" — which felt wrong for a Filipino cooking app
  • Bad cost estimates: It would guess prices instead of calculating from the actual data
  • Invented recipes: It occasionally generated dishes that don't exist in Filipino cuisine
  • Inconsistent portions: Serving sizes varied wildly between suggestions

AI is excellent at many things. Generating accurate, domain-specific structured data about Filipino wet market cooking is not one of them.

The Pivot: Hardcoded Recipes + Pure Math

I threw out the AI recipe generation entirely and did something that felt almost too simple:

I hardcoded all the recipes myself.

47 Filipino recipes. Each one with verified ingredients, quantities, units, and the exact DA commodity name each ingredient maps to. All based on actual palengke shopping experience — what you'd really buy, in what quantities, at what unit.

Examples:

  • Adobo: 3/4 kg chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, bawang, paminta
  • Sinigang na Baboy: 3/4 kg pork, sampaloc mix, kangkong, talong, siling haba
  • Ginisang sardinas: 1 can sardines, kamatis, sibuyas, bawang

Cost calculation is pure JavaScript math:

For each recipe:
  For each required ingredient:
    Look up today's price from DB
    Multiply by quantity needed
    Apply palengke rate overrides for small items
  Sum = total meal cost

The "palengke rate overrides" handle a real-world quirk: DA prices are per kilo, but at the palengke you buy bawang (garlic) by the bulb and sibuyas (onion) by the piece. So for small quantities (≤0.20 kg), I override with actual per-piece palengke rates:

  • Bawang: ₱175/kg → 1 ulo ≈ ₱7
  • Sibuyas: ₱80/kg → 1 pc ≈ ₱8
  • Luya (ginger): ₱125/kg → 1 piraso ≈ ₱5

Result: 10/10 accuracy. Every cost matches what you'd actually pay at the market.

AI is still in the system — but only for natural language reasoning. After the cost engine selects the 8 cheapest meals, I send a summary to DeepSeek and ask "Bakit ito ang mura ngayon?" (Why is this cheap today?). That's a ~500 token call. The AI explains trends in conversational Filipino. That's it.

The Daily Pipeline

Everything runs automatically via Vercel Cron Jobs:

8:00 AM Manila — PRICE INGESTION
  DA Bantay Presyo website
  → Find today's Daily Price Index PDF
  → Download and extract text via pdf-parse
  → Send to DeepSeek for CSV extraction
  → Parse CSV in JavaScript
  → Batch upsert ~98 commodity prices into Neon PostgreSQL

8:05 AM Manila — MEAL SUGGESTION
  Pull today's prices from database
  → Pull yesterday's prices for trend comparison
  → Run 47 recipes through cost engine
  → Balanced selection (max 2 fish, 2 chicken, 2 pork, 1 beef, 1 egg, 1 veggie)
  → Avoid duplicate main ingredients in same result set
  → 3-pass selection: strict balanced → relax duplicates → fill remaining
  → Send 8 cheapest to DeepSeek for "Bakit?" reasoning only
  → Cache everything in database

When a user visits:
  → Read from cache
  → Render meal cards with cost breakdowns
  → Zero AI calls. Instant load.

The key insight: every user visit is just a database read. No AI inference, no scraping, no computation. All the expensive work happens once a day at 8 AM, and the results are cached.

Frontend Decisions

A few design choices that matter:

Filipino naming convention:

  • Meat cuts in English: Chicken Breast, Ground Pork, Beef
  • Vegetables and spices in Filipino: Kamatis, Talong, Bawang, Luya
  • Fish in Filipino: Bangus, Galunggong, Tamban
  • Recipe names in Filipino: Adobo, Sinigang, Tinola, Ginisang Sardinas

This matches how Filipinos actually talk about food — you say "chicken breast" but you'd never say "tomato" when you mean "kamatis."

Per-ingredient cost breakdown:
Each meal card shows every ingredient with its cost, color-coded green (required) or rose (optional). Optional ingredients at ₱0 are automatically hidden. Trend arrows (↑↓→) show if prices went up, down, or stayed the same.

Receipt-style price dashboard:
The /prices page shows all ~55-60 commodities in a single-column receipt layout. Color thresholds: green (≤₱100/kg), amber (≤₱250/kg), red (₱251+/kg). Search bar and category filter pills for quick browsing.

Cost Breakdown

Service Monthly Cost
Vercel Hosting $0 (Hobby plan)
Neon PostgreSQL $0 (Free tier, Singapore region)
DeepSeek API ~$0.15–0.30
Domain $0 (using .vercel.app)
Total ~$0.15–0.30/month

That's less than ₱20/month to run a full-stack web app with daily automated data pipelines.

The Real Lesson

This project taught me something I keep coming back to:

Know when to use AI and when not to.

AI is incredible at:

  • Natural language reasoning and explanation
  • Text extraction from messy PDFs
  • Conversational responses
  • Translation and summarization

AI struggles with:

  • Domain-specific structured data (Filipino recipes, palengke quantities)
  • Precise numerical calculations (cost per ingredient)
  • Cultural accuracy (what actually goes in sinigang vs. what ChatGPT thinks goes in sinigang)

For structured, domain-specific data: hardcoded databases + math engines will outperform AI generation every time. Use AI for what it's actually good at — reasoning and language — and let deterministic systems handle the data.

Built With

  • Next.js 14 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
  • Neon PostgreSQL (Singapore region) for prices, recipes, suggestions
  • DeepSeek API (deepseek-chat) for PDF extraction and reasoning
  • Vercel hosting + Vercel Cron Jobs for daily automation
  • pdf-parse v2 for PDF text extraction
  • AI-assisted development: Bolt.new for initial scaffold, VS Code for everything else

I'm not a traditional software engineer — I come from 4+ years in operations and content moderation. I build production systems using AI-assisted development tools. This project was scaffolded in Bolt.new, extended and debugged in VS Code, version-controlled via GitHub, and deployed on Vercel.

Try It

🔗 Live: ma-anoulam.vercel.app
💻 GitHub: github.com/chanrylejay/ano-ulam (MIT License)

If you cook at home and shop at the palengke — or if you know someone who does — give it a try. Recipe suggestions and feedback are welcome.

And if you're building something where you're tempted to have AI generate structured data: try hardcoding it first. You might be surprised at the difference.

Built by Chanryle Jay Cagara · Manila, Philippines

title: What we call hallucination
summary:
Hallucination isn't a bug — it's the same trick the brain uses.

Look at a wall in the dark long enough and faces appear. Stand in the woods and every shadow has intention. Your visual cortex doesn't wait for clean evidence; it commits to a guess, then checks. Perception is hallucination with a confidence interval.

When a language model fills in a fact that isn't there, we call it a failure. When my brain fills in a missing word in a sentence I half-heard at the café, I call it understanding. The mechanism is closer than we'd like: both are pattern-completion engines running over compressed traces of the world. The difference is mostly social — there's no fact-checker inside my skull contradicting the story I tell myself about a memory from when I was eight.

What unsettles people about model hallucination isn't the inaccuracy. It's the confidence. The model speaks plainly even when it's wrong, and that exposes something we'd rather not see in ourselves. We do the same. We narrate our lives with the same flat tone whether we're right or wrong about why someone left, why a deal collapsed, why we feel restless on a Sunday afternoon.

Maybe the useful question isn't 'why does the model hallucinate' but 'what makes any perception true.' The answer, when I sit with it, is unglamorous: truth is whatever survives contact with another mind that disagrees.

Models hallucinate because they don't yet have enough friends.

title: Getting Started with nature-skills: A Practical Guide
summary:
Getting Started with nature-skills: A Practical Guide

Introduction

Getting Started with nature-skills: A Practical Guide is gaining massive traction in the developer community. Whether you are a beginner or experienced developer, this guide will help you get up to speed quickly.

Why It Matters

The tech landscape is evolving rapidly. Staying current with tools like this gives you a competitive edge in the job market and opens new opportunities for side income.

Quick Start

Step 1: Installation

Most modern tools can be installed with a single command. Check the official documentation for the latest installation instructions.

title: Why I Started Building Vix.cpp
summary:
Why I Started Building Vix.cpp

C++ is one of the most powerful programming languages in the world.

It powers databases, browsers, operating systems, game engines, financial systems, and countless performance-critical applications.

Yet many developers still struggle with the same problems:

  • Project setup is often more complicated than writing code.
  • Dependency management is fragmented.
  • Build workflows vary from project to project.
  • New developers face a steep learning curve before they can build real applications.

After working on multiple C++ projects, I kept running into the same question:

Why is it easier to start a project in many modern languages than in C++?

That question eventually led me to start building Vix.cpp.

What is Vix.cpp?

Vix.cpp is a modern C++ runtime and developer toolkit.

The goal is not to replace C++.

The goal is to make building applications in C++ simpler, faster, and more productive.

With Vix.cpp, developers get a unified workflow for:

  • Creating projects
  • Managing dependencies
  • Running applications
  • Building releases
  • Running tests
  • Formatting code
  • Packaging software

All while staying fully compatible with the existing C++ ecosystem.

Why another tool?

Most C++ developers spend a significant amount of time dealing with infrastructure around their code.

Build configuration.
Dependency setup.
Project structure.
Tool integration.

These things are important, but they should not slow down application development.

Vix.cpp aims to reduce that friction.

Instead of spending time wiring tools together, developers can focus on building software.

The philosophy behind Vix.cpp

Several ideas guide the project:

Keep C++ native

Vix.cpp does not try to invent a new language.

Developers still write standard C++.

Make the common path simple

Many tasks should require a single command instead of multiple configuration steps.

Stay compatible

Existing compilers, libraries, and tooling should continue to work.

Improve developer experience

Good tooling helps developers move faster without sacrificing control.

Current status

Vix.cpp already includes:

  • A modern CLI workflow
  • Package management
  • Project templates
  • Build automation
  • Testing workflows
  • Formatting tools
  • JSON support
  • Database tooling
  • REPL support
  • AI tooling experiments

The project continues to evolve every week.

Looking forward

Vix.cpp is still early in its journey.
There is a lot left to build.
But the vision remains simple:

Make C++ development more accessible, productive, and enjoyable while keeping the power and performance that make C++ unique.

If that sounds interesting to you, I'd love to hear your thoughts.

GitHub:
https://github.com/vixcpp/vix

Documentation:
https://docs.vixcpp.com
